note: nitrolean accepts mdata around a constructor type in an inductive declaration; Lean rejects it (invalid return type). No proof of False follows: mdata is transparent
nitrolean accepts mdata around a recursor rule's right-hand side; Lean rejects it (invalid recursor). No proof of False follows
nitrolean rejects a constructor record whose isUnsafe flag differs from its safe inductive type; Lean derives the constructor itself and accepts

nitrolean accepts an inductive block whose type record says unsafe while its constructors and recursor say safe; Lean rejects it. It takes the block as unsafe, so safe declarations that use it are still rejected: no proof of False found
the same on a non-positive inductive: accepted without the positivity check, as an unsafe block
nitrolean accepts mdata around the type of Quot.ind; Lean's quotient check rejects it. No proof of False follows
nitrolean rejects a recursor record whose isUnsafe flag differs from its safe inductive type; Lean derives the recursor itself and accepts

nitrolean rejects an inductive type record whose isRec flag is wrong; Lean computes the flag itself and accepts (the same holds for the other derived counts and flags of type records: isReflexive, numNested)
